set.rappels: One or two occasional single-rope rappels over 4th- and low-5th-class steps on the ridge; carry a 50-60 m rope
set.rappel_count_note: Parties make one or two single-rope-length rappels where they choose to, over the 4th-class and low-5th-class steps along the ridge; where these fall is not published, so no stations are listed.
